C1535.title: Post-Quantum Blockchain: A Survey on Cryptographic Resilience Against Quantum Computing Attacks
C1535.summary: A survey published on January 23, 2020, highlights that while blockchains rely on public-key cryptography and hash functions for security, advances in quantum computing make attacks based on Shor's and Grover's algorithms feasible in the near term.
